items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: Cause they were more interested in bands like the Savoy Sultans, they stayed up there, because the people were jumping more to that type of band, than they were Benny Carter's band. So they liked a band like the Sultans and Erskine Hawkins, type of band came and stayed there.

ctx.x: Yes, we didn't stay too long up there with the band, because the work was very -- you know at that time they would like hire one week-end then maybe after a couple of weeks, we'd go up there for another couple days, something like that, because it wasn't regular. They didn't keep any band up there, that type, you know, any length of time. Cause they were more interested in bands like the Savoy Sultans, they stayed up there, because the people were jumping more to that type of band, than they were Benny Carter's…
So they liked a band like the Sultans and Erskine Hawkins, type of band came and stayed there.
Now did you work with Fletch, when was that, was that around '41?
